configuration.executor: one dedicated caller thread per client
configuration.input_prefix_fingerprint: FNV-1a 64-bit over the first 100 measurement batches per client, including physical canonical key bytes and payload bytes
configuration.measurement_slot_schedule: each client starts a local phase operation index at zero; slot is phase index modulo pool size

engine_health.scope: backend worker process; detailed samples are nested in memory_only_diagnostic.engine_health_reports

final_validation.revision_progression_scope: each acknowledged write advances the same slot revision; final and reopened per-key revisions exactly match the latest acknowledged revision, while untouched slots retain their baseline revision; keys in each acknowledged batch share one revision

latency.histogram_binning_schema: exact integer nanoseconds below 1024; 1024 equal-width sub-buckets per binary exponent thereafter; percentile is the bucket upper bound
latency.sampling: all acknowledged batch completions counted in fixed buckets

memory_only_diagnostic.backend_process_definition: backend, service adapter, runtime, and loopback transport in the worker process; not a pure native allocator RSS measurement

engine_health.sampling_scope: measurement admission and drain only; warmup and validation excluded
no engine query or sampler thread

memory_only_diagnostic.label: memory-only diagnostic; loopback QUIC/TLS transport adds costs and does not replace direct-path throughput or latency evidence
memory_only_diagnostic.process_group_scope: sum of sampled harness-process and backend-process RSS/PSS for the recorded PID/starttime identities

residency_scans.conclusion: the second bounded full Scan matched the reopened data oracle with zero vdev read delta and zero backend-process Swap

first_scan_cache_warmup.bounded_worker_materialization: one protocol page at a time; no full-result worker materialization

residency_scans.scope: this second bounded Scan only; not a retrospective proof of earlier benchmark residency

second_scan.bounded_worker_materialization: one protocol page at a time; no full-result worker materialization

vdev_mapping.scope: whole host device counter; unrelated concurrent I/O is not attributed to this workload

process_metrics.sampling_scope: measurement phase including admission and drain; warmup and final validation excluded

reopen_validation.revision_progression_scope: each acknowledged write advances the same slot revision; final and reopened per-key revisions exactly match the latest acknowledged revision, while untouched slots retain their baseline revision; keys in each acknowledged batch share one revision
